questions.question: The chemical name of table salt is _______.
questions.solution:
The correct option is **2** i.e. __**Sodium chloride**__.

 
• The chemical name of table salt is sodium chloride.
 
• Its chemical formula is **NaCl**.
 
• It is essential to maintain the **electrolyte balance of fluids** in the human body.
 
• It is often used as a preservative.
 
• The body uses salt to **absorb and transport nutrients**, **maintain blood pressure**, **transmit nerve signals** and **contract and relax muscles**.

questions.question: The green pigment present in leaves is called ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**chlorophyll**__.

__**Explanation:**__

__
 
• Chlorophyll is a pigment present in the chloroplast which gives green colour to plants.
 
• Chlorophyll is a leaf that is required for trapping light energy.__
 
• The energy trapped by chlorophyll is used to synthesize food from carbon dioxide and water.
 
• It exists in several forms but chlorophyll a and chlorophyll b are the most common.
 
• Chlorophyll a is the chief pigment associated with photosynthesis.
 
• It is found in all photosynthetic organisms such as cyanobacteria.
 
• Plants cannot synthesize their food without the help of chlorophyll.
 
• Solar energy is stored in the form of food in the leaves with the help of chlorophyll.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• **Photosynthesis **is the process by which plants use **sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to create oxygen and energy in the form of sugar.**
 
• During photosynthesis, plants take in **carbon dioxide (CO2) and water (H2O) from the air and soil.**
 
• Within the plant cell, the** water is oxidized, meaning it loses electrons, while the carbon dioxide is reduced, meaning it gains electrons. This transforms the water into oxygen and the carbon dioxide into glucose.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d84acb97efc4a43562014b7ba2d9bc8b57e9a1fdf156d01ebb54d566312556d0.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Phloem **is tissue in plants that **conduct food** to other parts of the plant.

 
 
• Phloem is also called **bast**.
 
 
 
• **The xylem **is a vascular tissue which **conveys water and dissolved minerals** to the rest of the plant.
 
 
• It also provides physical support.

questions.question: The full form of DNA is:
questions.solution:
The correct option is **3** i.e __**Deoxyribonucleic acid**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The full form of DNA is **Deoxyribonucleic acid**.
 
• DNA is the carrier of genetic material. Genes present as series of** ATGC sequences** and packed as helical structure are coherently called as DNA.
 
• DNA is also responsible for introducing mutations in the species by random rearrangement of gene sequences or "recombination" during reproduction.
 
• DNA structure was given in **1953 **by **Dr James Watson and Dr Francis Crick** with the help of Rosalind Franklin via** X-ray crystallography of DNA** molecule.
 
• DNA is a genetic carrier in human beings animals, bacteria etc.
